assertions.name: has-skeleton-loading
assertions.description: Shows skeleton cards during loading, not a plain spinner

assertions.name: has-empty-state
assertions.description: Shows EmptyState when data array is empty

assertions.name: has-error-with-retry
assertions.description: Shows error message with refetch/retry button

assertions.name: uses-flash-list
assertions.description: Uses FlashList instead of FlatList or map()

prompt: Design a patient list screen that fetches from an API. Handle all states: loading (skeleton), empty, error (with retry), success. Use TanStack Query and FlashList.
